## Où j'en suis
Dashboards v2 is past the demo groundwork: PR #418 (draggable/resizable grid, recharts) is merged, and the follow-up PR #423 on branch `tom/dashboard-keyboard` adds keyboard move/resize with a custom `useGridKeyboard()` hook (no dnd-kit) plus a visible focus ring; it's open, awaiting Priya's review. The `dashboards_v2` flag is on for the zest-grocers workspace on staging only; production stays off until Tom flips it himself the morning of the demo on Tuesday the 24th. The old visx migration idea is settled: #401 was closed for good, nothing from it reached main, and recharts is the only chart lib. (source: ses-db-4, ses-db-3, src-pr418, src-pr401)

- [en-cours] PR #423 "Dashboards v2: keyboard move/resize + focus ring" open on `tom/dashboard-keyboard`, commit `8f1a2c7`, 11 new tests green (source: ses-db-4)
- [prochaine-étape] Priya reviews #423, then Tom flips `dashboards_v2` to on in production himself the morning of the 24th for the Zest demo (source: ses-db-4, ses-db-2)
- [essai-raté] dnd-kit's KeyboardSensor on top of react-grid-layout: both listen to the same events, moves applied twice and mouse drags fired two layout changes; replaced by the custom hook (source: ses-db-4)
- [décision] keep recharts, two chart libs rejected; #401 closed permanently (source: ses-db-3, src-pr401)
- [décision] v1 dashboards stay available behind the flag until January, nothing removed now; Zest demo is Tuesday the 24th with the flag on only for their workspace (source: ses-db-2)
- [décision] ResizeObserver hook (`useWidgetSize`) instead of CSS container queries, which don't work on Zest's iOS 15 iPads (source: ses-db-2)
- [question] whether keyboard move/resize in #423 meets Priya's expectations, pending her review (source: ses-db-4)
